why: The card no longer checks that the holding card is still up. An error reported against the bundle after boot has taken over, such as a late throw the boot handler also sees, then wipes the running game and puts a load failure in its place.
killedBy: index.html entry bundle failure card (issue #770) does nothing once boot has retired the holding card
index.html entry bundle failure card (issue #770) shows one card for a failure reported twice, keeping the first cause
